items.question: What qualities mark the discourse of the true Kaula scholar who conquers assemblies?
premises: His speech shows youthful strength expansion.
His speech is preceded by meter ornament.
items.inference: The verse presents youthful vigor and metrical ornament as marks of the true Kaula scholar's discourse.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic role of the instrumental phrase is unclear from two tokens alone.
items.plain_english: His speech expands with youthful strength and is adorned with meter and ornament.
